programmes.d: Police discover the dead body of Andrew Hopper clutching a syringe and covered with blood. The body is in Dr. G’s hands, as are the clues to solving the case.
Dr. G must determine if a teen boy died by taking his own life, but the autopsy leads to a more shocking and tragic conclusion.
A 71-year-old man wakes in the middle of the night, gasping for air. Paramedics rush to save him, but it’s all in vain: he’s dead by the time they arrive. What caused his death?
In the last-ever solo dates, the farmers have one last chance to see where their feelings lie.
The farmers hit the road to visit the first of their two ladies' families.
The four farmers embark on round two of meeting their potential future in-laws.
There's tears, love, and heartbreak as the farmers offer their hearts to the woman of their dreams.
Host Jennifer Nettles and the cast debrief their farm life journey and their quest to find love.
Four new farmers. One new host.
An urgent care physician must invent creative ways to save a choking child.
A woman's pregnancy veers toward tragedy as eclampsia threatens both her life and that of her child.
A violent patient faking a coma holds doctors and police hostage after stealing a policeman's gun.
A fishing lure embedded in a man's face turns out to be the least of his problems.
A man itching from poison oak exposure turns out to also have maggots burrowing into an injury on his back.
Two car crash victims, a man and a woman, arrive separately and nearly naked.
A girl is impaled through the neck on an iron fence. A patient is convinced he's turning into a vampire.
The ER becomes a dangerous place when smuggled drugs are found in a patient's belly.
Two seemingly unrelated gunshot wounds lead to a bizarre night in the ER.
A woman's thigh is impaled with a piece of rebar. A man brings his girlfriend into the ER for an STD workup.
When a man with a hand injury passes out from abdominal pain, tests lead to a shocking discovery.
A wrist fracture turns into a medical mystery. Two fishermen get stuck on the same lure.
Dr. G must figure out if a man died as a result of his infected stab wound or if his history of drug abuse was the culprit.
Both natural disease and sports injury are likely suspects in Eric Brody's death. But then Dr. G learns that he was treated with antibiotics for a spider bite prior to his death.
Paramedics respond to a mother in distress: one of her infant twin girls hasn’t woken up. By the time help arrives, it’s too late. But there is no apparent cause of death.
A hiker stumbles across a man's dead body in the woods. The victim's brother is convinced he was murdered. Dr. G must get to the bottom of this case. Was foul play really involved?
A hotel clerk calls 9-1-1 complaining of severe facial trauma, but he has no recollection of what happened and dies soon after. Police are counting on Dr. G to aid them in this investigation.
